name: Grim Soul: Survival Magic RPG
description:
STEP INTO THE DARKNESS

• Explore a Dark and Mysterious World
Step into the Plaguelands – a cursed realm where death is never far. Every forest hides a threat, every ruin breathes with old magic, and no path is truly safe. Discover long-abandoned castles, forbidden temples, and ancient altars buried in shadow.

• Enter the Challenging Dungeons
Beneath the surface lie ever-changing dungeons filled with traps, cursed guardians, and powerful relics. Each descent is a risk – few return, and none return unchanged.

• Follow Quests and Uncover Secrets
Ravens bring whispers of danger and reward. Track forgotten letters and torn scrolls to uncover the truth behind the Gray Decay – but beware, some truths are guarded for a reason.


SURVIVE AND BUILD

• Survive and Craft
Gather resources, hunt, and craft everything from weapons and armor to tools and supplies. Hunt wild beasts before they hunt you, and scavenge ruins for rare components. Each crafted item is a small step toward survival.

• Build a Fortress
Raise your walls high – this world will try to break them. Fortify your shelter against waves of the undead, enemy raiders, and things that roam the night. Only the well-prepared survive.


FIGHT AND JOIN FORCES

• Engage in Tactical Combat
Fight for your life with weapons forged by your own hands. Every swing counts. Time your strikes, dodge with precision, and face enemies who don’t feel pain or fear.

• Join a Clan
Face the Plaguelands alone and you’ll fall. Join forces with oth
